title: Wireless charging pad usability
summary: Feedback on the G70 wireless charging pad centers on charging speed, heat, phone fit, and console placement, with many fragments too brief or ambiguous to support a firm sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive feedback is limited and points to the pad being usable as an integrated feature, though the example is sparse and partly comparative.

negative.summary: Negative feedback cites slow or inconsistent charging, awkward placement behind cupholders, and interference with phone connectivity while on the pad.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention slow or ineffective charging, heat, limited compatibility, access issues, and desired design changes, but several examples are too fragmentary to classify confidently.

limitations: Most undetermined examples do not provide enough context to distinguish a clear complaint from a suggestion or simple mention.
Several fragments are extremely short placeholder-like entries, which limits reliable interpretation.
The positive evidence is sparse and partly references another vehicle, so it offers limited direct support about the G70 experience.
This topic mixes direct charging performance comments with broader packaging and feature-request remarks about charger location and capacity.
